Once upon a time, there lived a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat yummy things. One day, Tim saw a big, tall tree. The tree was tall and tall. Tim wanted to see what was inside the tree.

Tim had to decide if he could swim to the tree. He thought about what to make the tall generous answer. He knew he would need to save his money for his little sister. So, he jumped to get his hands.

In the end of the big tree, Tim gave his little sister some money. She said, "Thank you for warning me"
